verdict.rationale: Brex offers a business account ("Brex business account"), and its Transactions API lists "accounts", so a banking axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents opening multiple checking sub-accounts or automatically splitting incoming deposits across them. Budgets and spend-limit allocation govern card spending, not deposit allocation, so they are an adjacent feature and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can open multiple checking sub-accounts and auto-allocate incoming deposits across them
